0022600102.text: The Clippers are 1-0 and sit 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West, while the Lakers are also 1-0 and sit 2nd in the Pacific and 5th in the West. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee, inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (foot, plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery), and the Lakers are without Adou Thiero (knee, inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique, strain), with Jake LaRavia listed as day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and their most recent meeting was a 125-122 Clippers loss in Los Angeles on February 20, 2026, with no games yet in the 2026-27 season series.
